name: Export-to-CI wizard Step 4 shows the install choices as a radiogroup
description: Proves AC-53: the Export-to-CI wizard's Step 4 (Install) presents the two install choices as a keyboard-operable radiogroup — the recommended 'Open a PR with these files' card (checked by default) and the 'Copy files as a zip' card ('add them manually') — plus a 'GitHub Action setup docs →' link. Drives the wizard: /agents → Security Reviewer editor → CI tab → '+ Add to CI' → Continue through Step 1 (Target, prefilled repo) → Step 2 (Preview) → Step 3 (Configure) → Step 4 (Install). PREREQUISITE (AC-55): reaching Step 2 fires the server export with action=files, which reads the ncc runner bundle at agent-runner/dist/index.js — the hermetic stack MUST run `cd agent-runner && pnpm build` first, else the export raises the parent AC-44 'Runner bundle not found' error and Step 4 is unreachable (designed behaviour, not a bug). The radiogroup SEMANTICS (role=radio, aria-checked, arrow-key roving, footer action) and the client-side zip download are covered deterministically by the RTL unit test (ExportWizard.test.tsx test_install_radiogroup / test_zip_download_files); this flow is the browser confirmation that Step 4 renders both cards + the docs link. All step controls are React onClick buttons, activated with native HTMLElement.click() evals (e2e/INSIGHTS.md 2026-07-06). LLM-free: no PR is opened and no zip is downloaded (the footer 'Install' is not clicked). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (acme/payments-api) with the runner bundle built.
